scope: Fourteen BASIC-facing named headings: dialogue entry points, zone/value access, array address and channel controls. Embedded Interface instructions/functions are separate and remain uninventoried here.
notes: Dialog Box, Dialog Run, Edialog and Dialog retain function roles; Dialog Open/Close are instructions. Later prose calling a function a command does not override its definition.
Interface programs and their significant capitals, separators, registers, labels and embedded commands stay opaque inside BASIC strings.
Rdialog/Rdialog$/Vdialog/Vdialog$, Array and Dialog Update/Freeze/Unfreeze/Clr now have BASIC lexical coverage. Resource controls remain §9.4 work.
Channel validity, optional parameter semantics, status/error results, event handling and original execution are unqualified.

Vdialog and Vdialog$ retain their function heading roles in both read and assignment contexts. Their short descriptions at 16764/16773 say string/value respectively, whereas signatures and prose at 16765–81 distinguish numeric Vdialog and string Vdialog$. Preserve the discrepancy without implementing type rules.
Array is the BASIC function at 16999; ArrayRead at 17015 is an embedded Interface function, not a BASIC alias.
